info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Currents-v5-spec
info.description: The Current Weather Alerts API provides real-time updates on weather alerts to keep users informed of critical weather conditions. It serves as a primary resource for applications needing to notify users about severe weather events such as storms, floods, or other impactful weather changes. Developers integrating this API can enhance user experience by delivering timely updates to various consumer platforms, including mobile applications and web services. Typical use cases include travel apps, emergency notification systems, and community safety platforms.
